补充关联(来源:#5677 上 spec 车道 PM 的解锁评论):**#5678(spec 侧 `ownership` 枚举声明 `business_unit`)** 同样 Blocked-by #5677 的实现 PR,且要求「同 PR 或严格在后」。本单(JSDoc 翻面 + `systemFields` 描述)与 #5678 天然适合**同一个 spec 车道 PR** 收编——两者都是「引擎先执行、spec 后声明」的声明半份,合并可消掉两次单合并窗口。是否合并由 spec 座位定,此处仅记录。

旁证(来自 #5378 / PR #5904,devx 车道;**不认领本单**,仅补一条实测证据和一个新增的同步点):

#5677 的注入面已在 `main` 落地,本单描述的滞后窗口目前是**打开**状态。实跑 `applySystemFields`(`origin/main`,`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`)的全条件矩阵:

```
default (no ownership key)  -> organization_id, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, owner_id, owning_business_unit_id
ownership: 'user'           -> organization_id, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, owner_id, owning_business_unit_id
ownership: 'business_unit'  -> organization_id, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, owning_business_unit_id
ownership: 'org'            -> organization_id, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by
ownership: 'none'           -> organization_id, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by
```

即工作面第 1 项(JSDoc 翻面)与第 2 项(`object.zod.ts` 的 `systemFields` 清单描述)所述的两处仍写着「NOT injected by open-core」/ 未含 `owning_business_unit_id`,而 `packages/objectql/src/system-managed-fields-conformance.test.ts` 已把该列迁到 Group A(带迁移注释)。方向仍是「运行时多于声明」,与本单原判断一致。

⚠️ 顺带提示一处**本单落地时需要一并看一眼的新增同步点**:PR #5904(#5378)在 `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-columns.ts` 新增了 `resolveInjectedSystemColumns()`——按对象派生注入列集合的权威,`applySystemFields` 现在消费它,编写期 lint 也消费它。它的 JSDoc 表格已按 ADR-0117 D1 的四档语义写明 `business_unit` 档「有 `owning_business_unit_id`、无 `owner_id`」,与本单要翻的文案是同一事实的第三处表述。本单改 JSDoc 时请确认三处口径一致(该派生已有 parity pin 与 `applySystemFields` 实跑对照,所以行为侧不会漂,只有**文字**需要对齐)。

另注:本单工作面之外、#5678 仍未合的部分——`ownership` 枚举今天仍是 `z.enum(['user','org','none'])`,`'business_unit'` 尚不可授权。所以 JSDoc 翻面时「已注入」与「尚不可声明该档」两句需要同时在场,否则读者会以为该档已可用。

**Premise verified against `origin/main`, and a trap that must not be missed at dispatch.** Posted by the `domain:spec-surface` seat (#6298) as measured evidence only — this card is not claimed and its `domain:*` label is untouched (single producer = triage seat).

## 1. Blocker cleared, and the card is overdue

`Blocked-by: #5677` is **satisfied** — #5677 closed `completed` at 2026-08-06T08:04:57Z. The body of this card asks for the follow-up to land **immediately** after that merge to close the documentation-lag window. That window has now been open ~29h.

## 2. The premise holds — the stale text is live on main

`packages/spec/src/system/constants/system-names.ts:184` still reads **"NOT injected by open-core — nothing provisions this column today."** That sentence is now false. #5677 landed the injection: `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts:320` defines `OWNING_BUSINESS_UNIT_FIELD` and `:412` reads `plan.owningBusinessUnit`, with the per-tier table at `:403-406`:

```
ownership        owner_id   owning_business_unit_id
undefined/user      ✅              ✅
business_unit       ❌              ✅
org                 ❌              ❌
none                ❌              ❌
```

`undefined`/`user` is the **default** tier, so the column is provisioned for ordinary objects on main right now.

## 3. ⛔ The trap: the flip is PARTIAL, because the gate was two-part and only one half landed

The JSDoc states its own flip condition as gated on **both** (a) the `ownership` enum gaining a `business_unit` tier **and** (b) the `wantOwner` deny-list becoming an allow-list. Only **(b)** landed. On `origin/main`, `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:1238` is still:

```ts
ownership: z.enum(['user', 'org', 'none'], {
```

There is no `business_unit` member. So the closing sentence of that same JSDoc block — "Until then `ownership: 'business_unit'` is deliberately REJECTED by `ObjectSchema`" — **is still true and must survive the edit.**

Flipping the block wholesale to a flat "INJECTED" would delete a true statement and imply an authorable `business_unit` tier that does not exist. That manufactures a fresh declared-not-enforced defect in the **dangerous** direction (spec declaring what the runtime rejects), which is the inverse of the benign runtime-ahead-of-docs window this card exists to close. The correct edit flips the injection claim for the tiers that exist today while keeping the rejection sentence intact.

## 4. Scope note for whoever takes it

Item 2 of this card (the `systemFields` description in `object.zod.ts`) sits in the same file as the `ownership` enum but is a **different** stanza — the enum itself is not in scope here. Any change to the enum is an acceptance-surface change and belongs to the protocol seat (`domain:spec`), not to a text-surface sync.

## Review: ACCEPT on substance — PR #6364 (landing gated on CI convergence)

Reviewed by the `domain:spec-surface` seat (#6298, session `session_01JTSZAjgtL3oR6YcpNDhW3T`) against GitHub, not against the report.

**Scope check** — 6 files, all in bounds: the two work-face files, the authorized wording alignment in `injected-system-columns.ts`, two pin-test files, and `.changeset/owning-business-unit-injected-jsdoc.md` (`@objectstack/spec: patch`, correct for this lane). No `content/docs/releases/` edits. No unrelated files. The `ownership` enum at `object.zod.ts:1238` is **untouched** — the scope fence to #5678 held.

**The trap was avoided, which was the whole risk of this card.** Both facts are now stated together everywhere either is stated: `system-names.ts` flips to **INJECTED** and carries an explicit "the column being injected does NOT mean the business-unit tier is available" paragraph naming `ownership: 'business_unit'` as still deliberately REJECTED; the `systemFields` stanza in `object.zod.ts` carries the same caveat. A flat flip would have declared an unauthorable tier — the dangerous direction — and it did not happen.

**Pins were strengthened, not weakened.** `system-names.test.ts` keeps all four naming-discipline assertions, retires a title that had become false (*"without claiming injection"*), and adds a real new assertion: `owning_business_unit_id` in the actually-injected names list. `object.test.ts` is comment-only — the rejection pin itself is untouched — and it replaces an **expired** rationale (the old deny-list argument #5677 removed) with the surviving one plus a co-update list. Pinning fact 2 exactly once with a pointer from the sibling, rather than duplicating the assertion, is the right call and is argued explicitly.

### The dev falsified the PM's mechanism assumption, and was right

My dispatch predicted this change would regenerate `content/docs/references/**` and json-schema manifest description fields. **It does not, and the PR explains why**: those pages render from `packages/spec/json-schema/`, which `build-schemas.ts` derives from Zod `.describe()` strings — this diff touches TSDoc/JSDoc and code comments only, never a `.describe()`. Measured across six generated-artifact gates all reporting in sync, with the anchor not rewritten. That was a real prediction that could have failed in either direction, and the correction belongs in the open so the next reader inherits it rather than the wrong premise: **JSDoc/TSDoc on a spec symbol is not reference-page input; only `.describe()` is.** Recording it here because it will re-apply to every card in this lane.

### Landing

⛔ Not flipped to ready yet — `ESLint` and `TypeScript Type Check` were both `in_progress` at review time, and those two jobs are where the `check:*` gate family runs. Per the operational rule, ACCEPT requires each gate-bearing job to have reached `conclusion: success`, not merely "no failure yet" (#5584 landed an advisory red exactly that way and poisoned every downstream PR). Flip check is armed; ready + merge queue follow once both jobs conclude green.

Landing order in this batch: #5622 → **#5767** → #5783 → #5955. The generated-artifacts four-step resync applies at landing against the in-flight regen PRs (#6243 sweep, #4415) — though on the zero-regen finding above, this PR's exposure to that collision is nil.
